body: I rush out of the room, my heart pounding, as I try to outrun the fear that has taken hold. I notice the crate is covered in dust and cobwebs, the once-vibrant paint now faded. I feel a chill run down my spine as I think about the tenant who left this mysterious package. I think about the tenant's potential plans for it, but my mind can't shake the feeling of danger that's following me. I put real distance between myself and it, trying to shake off the unsettling feeling.
